# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.0.9 · Mac 3.0.3

## Mac app 3.0.3

- The app's signature now covers the whole app, not only the program inside it. Downloads from this page should again offer **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** the first time instead of saying the app is damaged.
- If you have 3.0.2, you do not need to download anything: the app offers this update itself (**Update and Restart**).

## Web

- No changes besides the version number.
